accents.$description: The accent axis (port-manifest §8.4), light resolution. v1 expressed this as a partial override — :root[data-theme="light"][data-accent="…"] restated only --accent (and --on-accent for teal/green/amber). Here every accent is written out fully: this file is the cascade already resolved, so Compose and CSS read the same numbers instead of one of them re-deriving them.

indigo.$description: Default accent. Darkened for AA on a light background.

accent-2.$description: Unchanged from dark — v1's light block does not override --accent-2.

on-accent.$description: Overridden in light: the darkened teal takes white text.
Overridden in light: the darkened green takes white text.
Overridden in light: the darkened amber takes white text.

accent.$description: The active accent. Defaults to indigo.

accent-2.$description: The active accent's lighter ramp step.
